finding: No structured live answer was obtained. Two reservations were spent on the same baseline request; seven other direct arms and both product arms were unattempted. All 46 obligations remain OPEN_QUALIFIED and 32 readings remain unformalized. Component adoption closes none.
scope: Review of retained component outputs, frozen source passages, prior dossiers and transport receipts. No new legal corpus, full-case rereading, later-treatment search or expert adjudication in T4.

p10.finding: Paragraph 10 and footnote 1 retain Product Provider responsibility despite outsourcing; paragraph 11 separately requires proper ownership records. These statements do not make a delegation contract, a retained power, a supervision event or a successful outcome a sufficient discharge test. Allocation, exercised conduct, outcomes and their combination remain rival fulfillment proposals. Footnote 1 imports Appendix Part A factors only where applicable. The p10 baseline timed out twice; its tool arm never ran, so no model comparison supports a stronger conclusion.
p10.missing_premises: Governing fulfillment standard, actor/capacity and scheme conditions, effective retained powers, assessed supervision, records and incident chronology within a stated assessment period.
p10.disposition: OPEN_QUALIFIED; source-to-standard and factual application unresolved

p14.finding: Paragraph 14 places 'upon SFC's request' between confirmation and demonstration; footnote 5 specifies minimum objects and a high level of confidence for vulnerabilities/security flaws. The existing A/B/C readings differ over attachment, objects and standards and remain conditional proposals. An absent request can affect the demonstration duty under a request-dependent reading; it does not prove confirmation, underlying compliance or fulfillment. Paragraph 15 audit/verification and paragraph 16 legal opinion have distinct request premises. No numeric confidence threshold follows from footnote 5. Neither live arm ran.
p14.missing_premises: Source argument choosing the attachment/standard, separate request identities and dates, confirmation/demonstration evidence and an applicable substantive assessment standard.
p14.disposition: OPEN_QUALIFIED; preserve rival readings and separate confirmation, demonstration, audit and legal opinion

evidence.finding: A supervision event or completed reconciliation records activity; the retained passages do not make either a sufficient condition for adequate supervision or proper ownership records. Paragraph 11 requires proper records, while Appendix Part A separately raises legal validity, extrinsic rights, encumbrances and reconciliation. A recorded event needs a governing sufficiency standard and scoped facts before it can support that normative judgment. Source text retrieval and CAES labels supplied with artificial weights add no such warrant. Neither live arm ran.
evidence.missing_premises: Applicable adequacy/propriety standard, completeness and quality of the activity, discrepancies and remediation, legal title/rights, actor identity, coverage of the assessment interval and contrary observations.
evidence.disposition: OPEN_QUALIFIED; activity-to-adequacy inference remains unsupported without these premises

gatecoin.finding: The 2023 conclusion distinguishes cryptocurrency's capacity to be trust property from an actual trust under the operative terms, preserving the non-consenting-customer exception. Terms and objective relationships matter; labels and agency alone are not conclusive. The 2025 decision carries forward that finding and distinguishes customer consent, pooled beneficial interests, ETD claims and the separate Samara relationship. Paragraph 8 treats scenario seven as absent, paragraph 95 groups five to seven in its exception wording, and the annexure gives its own categories. This tension remains unresolved. These exchange-insolvency decisions supply factors to investigate, not a universal 26EC22 fulfillment test. Neither live arm ran.
gatecoin.missing_premises: Specific target actors and rights, governing law and operative terms, acceptance/consent evidence, analogous facts and a warranted legal transfer; complete later treatment and reconciliation of the scenario-seven passages.
gatecoin.disposition: OPEN_QUALIFIED; no current-treatment certification or automatic target classifier

sara-ie.finding: Retained root reuse licence remains unverified; tax-domain extraction and training assumptions are not qualified for these sources.
sara-ie.limit: Deferred without model installation or target extraction trial.
sara-ie.overturn: Verified reuse terms and a reviewed target-specific training/evaluation protocol.

hypo-cato-agatha.finding: Source-bound factor and distinction records exist; no installable original engine was verified or run.
hypo-cato-agatha.limit: Conceptual reuse only. The selected Gatecoin distinctions need legal review; no end-to-end case-comparison benefit was measured.
hypo-cato-agatha.overturn: A runnable qualified implementation and source-checked target comparison would support a stronger capability claim.

clerc.finding: Pinned repository inspected; a retrieval-subtree licence is retained, but whole-repository/corpus reuse and target deployment were not established.
clerc.limit: Original CLERC engine/corpus deferred. The separate rank-bm25 trial is not CLERC.
clerc.overturn: Established deployment/reuse scope and a bounded trial on the target questions.

logical-english.finding: The repaired SWI environment loads the parser, but both intended positive examples still report declaration errors. Parsed terms are emitted without acceptance.
logical-english.limit: Defer this local runtime/adapter; the positive controls fail. This does not reject controlled language as a research direction. No parser repair remains in this program.
logical-english.overturn: A separately reviewed runtime/authoring repair that passes positive and malformed controls would justify reconsideration, still without proving source equivalence.

eyecite.finding: US full-citation and Id. controls were recognized; neither of the two Hong Kong citations nor the UK citation was recognized.
eyecite.limit: Defer the Hong Kong route. These are three missed examples, not a measured jurisdiction-wide recall rate. No linked-case resolution or current-treatment capability was shown.
eyecite.overturn: A justified Hong Kong extension with retained positive/negative and resolution controls could qualify a narrower route.

legalruleml.finding: Official compact-schema reference, deontic and alternative examples validated; an invented-element negative control was rejected.
legalruleml.limit: Optional schema validator only. No product roundtrip, semantic preservation or source-to-rule equivalence was tested.
legalruleml.overturn: Incorrect acceptance/rejection under the official schema or a lossy future product roundtrip; schema validity never licenses a legal equivalence claim.

retrieval.finding: rank-bm25 0.2.2 ranked the identical retained corpus and returned unchanged source text and identities.
retrieval.limit: k1=1.5, b=0.75, epsilon=0.25 and top-8 are convenience hypotheses. Whole documents and short paragraphs are mixed; broad documents often outrank the precise provision. No relevance labels, recall claim, model effect or CLERC deployment.
retrieval.overturn: Changed source text/identity invalidates this capability. A missing decisive passage vetoes relevance for that question even if ranking succeeds.

pyarg.finding: 532 graphs matched local grounded/preferred results: all 531 directed graphs on zero to three arguments including self-attacks, plus the retained eight-argument graph.
pyarg.limit: Optional checker for supplied abstract defeat graphs. ASPIC argument construction, legal priorities, source meaning and actual product output checking were not demonstrated.
pyarg.overturn: A reproducible grounded/preferred mismatch on a graph within the supported adapter profile or loss of an argument/attack.

carneades.finding: The same 532 Dung graphs matched; seven CAES controls covered a present/absent premise, equal opposition, undercutting and PE/CCE/BRD examples.
carneades.limit: CAES weights are artificial inputs; pinned alpha=0.5 and beta=0.3 are implementation thresholds, not Hong Kong legal thresholds. Out means nonacceptance, not legal falsity. Product integration was not run.
carneades.overturn: A failed declared control, unmatched graph semantics, or a downstream adapter treating Out as falsity.

remaining_work: Justify the governing paragraph 10 fulfillment standard and paragraph 14/footnote 5 attachment; supply standards connecting supervision, reconciliation and incidents to adequacy/propriety; identify target actors, terms, time period and facts; establish case applicability and current treatment; formalize and validate the remaining 32 readings individually. A future live comparison needs a functioning approved provider route. None of these gaps is closed by more graph solving, XML validation or retrieval alone. No successor is scheduled.
